summary: mission-marz is our concept for a browser-based 3D space architecture simulator designed to test what it truly takes to sustain human life on the Red Planet. The idea combines interactive 3D base construction with real-world NASA Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) telemetry—challenging users to balance payload budgets, power demand, oxygen production, and water recycling to keep a crew alive across a 30-day mission.
details:
3D Martian Base Builder & Life-Support Survival Simulator An interactive browser-based 3D space architecture game set on Jezero Crater. Design self-sustaining Martian habitats, balance real NASA telemetry, and test your colony across a 30-day endurance simulation.

Core Gameplay Objective • Establish an interconnected, self-sustaining human outpost on Jezero Crater, Mars. • Configure crew size (1–7 astronauts), budget caps, and transit parameters before launch. • Built with Three.js WebGL & real NASA Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) data.

Three Deployment Workflows • Tutorial (Guided): Step-by-step interactive walkthrough of 3D camera controls and auto-tunnels. • Preset Base (Certified): Pre-assembled colony with all 10 essential modules ready to simulate. • From Scratch (24×24 Grid): Blank Martian regolith canvas for custom colony engineering.
Expanded 24×24 Martian Grid • Snap modules onto a calibrated 6-meter Martian grid using intuitive 3D orbit, pan, and zoom controls. • 90° rotation and instant placement previews ensure precise spatial planning. • Pressurized connector tubes with safety luminescence strips auto-link adjacent pods.
11 Specialized Pod Categories • Essential Life Support: Main Living Pods, MOXIE Oxygen Generation, and Water Recycling. • Power & Infrastructure: Small Modular Nuclear Reactors, Solar Arrays, and Energy Monitors. • Science & Mobility: Hydroponic Greenhouses, Med Bays, Rover Garages, and Comms Towers.

Real-Time Resource Balancing • Tracks Total Base Spend ($), Rocket Lift Mass (tonnes), and Crew Bunk Capacity. • Calculates net Electrical Power Bus (kW) and Water Reserves (L/day) with every added pod. • Includes a live 2D Tactical Radar synced to your 3D camera yaw.
Advisory Diagnostics Engine • Automatically detects engineering flaws—such as Power Grid Overload Deficits or Net Negative Water Balance. • Provides actionable fix recommendations (e.g., deploying a Nuclear Power Pod or Rodriguez Well) prior to launch.

Stage 1: Earth-to-Mars Hohmann Transfer • 210-day interplanetary spacecraft transit from 1.00 AU to 1.52 AU. • Displays live orbital velocity (23.7 km/s), distance traveled (225.3M km), and Deep Space Network latency.
Stage 2: Autonomous Robotic Welding (Sol 1–14) • Automated regolith sintering and laser welding construct each pod in sequence. • Pressurized tunnel interconnects seal the habitat network before crew arrival.

Dynamic Martian Surface Environment • Simulates 30 Earth days across Martian Sols with day/night cycles, temperature swings (-51°C), and cabin pressure monitoring. • Features animated astronauts, surface rovers, and autonomous drones patrolling the perimeter.

Real-Time Hazard & Crisis Events • Tests colony resilience against severe dust storms, thermal stress cycles, and solar flare radiation alerts. • Crew automatically musters to radiation shelters while ECLSS loops maintain life support.

100-Point Habitability Rating • Evaluates mission success across six core subsystems: Power, Oxygen, Water, Crops/Food, Structural Integrity, and Crew Morale. • Certifies whether primary and secondary ECLSS loops sustained the crew for all 30 days.

Iterative Base Optimization • Generates post-mission optimization steps (e.g., adding secondary MOXIE units or Greenhouses for positive surplus). • Players can return directly to the 3D grid to expand and refine their colony.
